profile.summary:
software engineer passionate about building best-in-class products

currently building metronome at stripe, the usage-based billing platform of choice for top ai & infra companies. previously, I worked at google, building backend systems for youtube music to drive launches for 100M+ users; & at yuzu, a fintech & web3 startup developing an ethereum-native investment platform for real-world asset-backed securities. I studied computer science & engineering at MIT. 

the best way to reach me is via email, which can be found at izzygomez.com. I read most emails, but have no response guarantees~

positions.title: Software and Electrical Engineer Intern
positions.description: Designed and tested printed circuit board (PCB) of A4990 Dual Motor Driver Shield for Arduino using Altium PCB Designer, Git, and various hardware testing tools (http://goo.gl/6ZhSNP, http://goo.gl/kQFwzi). Developed corresponding Arduino software library, simplifying use of Shield with brushed DC motors. Final product solved issue of providing inexpensive motor driver capabilities to the Arduino platorm.
